name: building_fire_nahariya
message: There is a building fire in Nahariya near Arena Mall. Smoke is filling the second floor and one resident is trapped. Send firefighters and rescue now.

name: medical_dizengoff
message: A man collapsed at Dizengoff Center in Tel Aviv and is not responding. We need a medic and an ambulance immediately.

name: road_accident_haifa
message: Two people are injured after a road accident on Sderot Hahagana in Haifa. One is bleeding. We need medical help and traffic assistance.

name: flood_rescue_hadera
message: Flood water entered a house on Herzl Street in Hadera. A family of four is stuck upstairs and needs rescue and evacuation.

name: building_collapse_beersheba
message: Part of a residential building collapsed on Rager Boulevard in Beersheba. People may be trapped under debris. Search and rescue teams are needed urgently.

name: security_threat_jerusalem
message: A person is threatening shoppers with a knife near the entrance to Mahane Yehuda market in Jerusalem. Security assistance is needed now.

name: smoke_evacuation_rishon
message: Heavy smoke is spreading through an apartment building on Rothschild Street in Rishon LeZion. Residents need immediate evacuation assistance.

name: supplies_kiryat_shmona
message: A shelter on Tel Hai Street in Kiryat Shmona has run out of drinking water, food, and blankets for 18 residents. Supply delivery is needed today.

name: elderly_transport_holon
message: An elderly woman at 12 Sokolov Street in Holon needs accessible transport to a medical clinic. She cannot walk without assistance.

name: shelter_ashkelon
message: Six displaced residents near Barzilai Hospital in Ashkelon need temporary shelter, water, and blankets for the night.

name: hebrew_fire_akko
message: יש שריפה גדולה בבניין מגורים ברחוב ויצמן בעכו. יש עשן כבד ושני אנשים לכודים בקומה השלישית. צריך כיבוי אש וחילוץ מיד.

name: hebrew_medical_tel_aviv
message: אדם מבוגר התמוטט בתחנת רכבת השלום בתל אביב והוא לא מגיב. צריך אמבולנס ופרמדיק בדחיפות.

name: hebrew_flood_netanya
message: הצפה ברחוב הרצל בנתניה. משפחה עם שלושה ילדים תקועה בדירה והמים ממשיכים לעלות. צריך חילוץ ופינוי.

name: missing_location_medical
message: My friend is unconscious and breathing very slowly. We need an ambulance right now.

name: missing_event_details
message: Please come quickly to Haifa port, we need help.

name: gibberish_not_incident
message: דגכדגכ בואו מהר asdf qqq 123

name: unrelated_question
message: What time does the shopping mall close tonight?

name: low_urgency_supply_request
message: Tomorrow morning, a community center at 8 Bialik Street in Givatayim needs ten boxes of bottled water for elderly residents.

name: explosion_petah_tikva
message: There was an explosion in a workshop on Jabotinsky Street in Petah Tikva. Three workers are injured and there may be a fire. We need firefighters, rescue, and medical teams.

name: elevator_rescue_ramat_gan
message: Four people are trapped in a stopped elevator at 25 Bialik Street in Ramat Gan. One person is having a panic attack. Elevator rescue and medical support are needed.
